final: WITH v AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country,'') AS country, CAST(a.points_won AS REAL)/a.points_max AS share FROM player_award_vote a JOIN player p ON p.player_id=a.player_id WHERE a.points_won IS NOT NULL AND a.points_max IS NOT NULL AND a.points_max<>0), c AS (SELECT country, AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM v GROUP BY country) SELECT country, avg_share, avg_share/(SELECT AVG(avg_share) FROM c) AS relative_ratio FROM c ORDER BY country
